Permit authorization scope for Outfall 001 on page 3
Adjacent pollutant rows sharing the same N/A limit columns with Report/1/Quarter monitoring pattern

grounding.detail: adjacent pages around 4 (pages 3–5: table headers, Outfall 001 authorization, adjacent pollutant rows)

rationale: The packet shows that the 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin row at Outfall 001 lists N/A across all effluent-limit columns while specifying Report / 1/Quarter / Grab in the measurement-frequency and sample-type columns, and that neighboring pollutants (e.g., Cadmium, Pentachlorophenol) follow the same N/A-plus-quarterly-report pattern. That structural context distinguishes limit columns from monitoring columns but does not meet the burden for ACCEPT: no numeric effluent discharge limit value is stated in the row, and the general authorization language that discharges 'shall be limited and monitored as specified below' does not supply a dioxin-specific numeric limit. It also does not meet the burden for REJECT: N/A in the table is not positive evidence that no enforceable numeric limit exists anywhere in the permit or regulatory basis, and the presence of quarterly reporting requirements does not establish the exclusive claim that the row establishes only monitoring without any associated numeric compliance limit. The packet itself flags that auto-assembly may be evidence-insufficient. Under P5, neither branch of the disjunctive question is sufficiently grounded, so UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
